instruction: Navigate to the ACL 2019 conference page on ACL Anthology and open the Long Papers proceedings volume.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent navigated ACL Anthology, browsed ACL 2021 long papers proceedings, searched for 'ACL 2021 best paper award' with no results, tried Google/Semantic Scholar but failed to identify award papers. Never entered data into spreadsheet. Hit 50-turn limit.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate ACL Anthology, browse conference proceedings pages, use search bars, switch between Chrome tabs. Can interact with LibreOffice Calc (file was open).
metadata.failure_analysis: Model failed because ACL Anthology does not label best paper awards on proceedings pages. The model spent all 50 turns searching for award info across multiple sites without success, never returning to edit the spreadsheet.
metadata.task_rationale: Decomposed navigation sub-task: model demonstrated it can navigate from ACL Anthology homepage to specific conference proceedings (did this for ACL 2021). This tests the same capability for ACL 2019.
metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to ACL 2019 long papers proceedings page on ACL Anthology (URL: aclanthology.org/volumes/P19-1/). Getter uses Chrome DevTools Protocol via port 9222 to reliably extract the active tab URL. Evaluator checks URL contains 'aclanthology.org', 'volumes', and 'P19-1'. Partial credit per URL component. [Fixed: replaced accessibility tree getter with CDP-based getter; corrected expected URL parts to match actual ACL Anthology URL structure (P19-1 volume code)]
fix_history: Fix 1: Replaced accessibility tree getter with CDP-based getter using curl to http://localhost:9222/json for reliable active tab URL extraction
Fix 2: Updated expected URL parts from ['aclanthology.org', 'acl-2019', 'long'] to ['aclanthology.org', 'volumes', 'P19-1'] to match actual ACL Anthology URL structure
Fix 3: Updated scoring_breakdown to reflect new URL parts

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly uses CDP via curl to http://localhost:9222/json to extract browser tab URLs. Chrome is launched with --remote-debugging-port=1337 and socat forwards to 9222, so the endpoint is available. Good error handling for empty responses and JSON parse failures.

Expected URL parts ['aclanthology.org', 'volumes', 'P19-1'] correctly match the actual ACL 2019 Long Papers proceedings URL (https://aclanthology.org/volumes/P19-1/). All three parts are necessary and sufficient to verify the correct page.

Metric correctly accesses expected.get('required_url_parts') directly, which is correct for type='rule' since get_rule returns the rules dict. Case-insensitive matching and partial credit scoring are appropriate.
Coverage is complete: the URL containing 'P19-1' on 'aclanthology.org/volumes/' verifies both navigating to ACL Anthology and opening the correct ACL 2019 Long Papers proceedings volume.

Minor concern: CDP /json endpoint returns tabs in creation order, and tabs[0] is not guaranteed to be the active/focused tab. If the agent opens multiple tabs, the getter might return the wrong tab's URL. However, for this simple navigation task with a fresh browser, this is unlikely to be an issue in practice.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider filtering CDP /json results for the active tab (e.g., check for 'type': 'page' and select the tab with the most recent navigation) instead of always using tabs[0], to improve robustness when multiple tabs are open.
